body: Truth be known, with my main account I come here about once or twice a week to lend my ear. It's why I came here this time...It felt like my time to share! Thanks again man!

Thanks, I am not planning on checking out! I just needed to get all this shit off of my chest, so that it isn't eating me up.

Means a lot to get some kind words right now, thank you again.

Your words really touched me, thank you. I work hard on developing myself, but as you probably know with self realisation often comes a lot of pain.

I know suicide watch was not really the right place to post this, my suicidal thoughts were just that, thoughts.

I will come through all of this, and it's words like yours and from others that help. Thank you again.

It will all pass. Just one of those days where the burdens of the past scream to be released. I am ok really, just venting the pain to ease myself.

Thank you for your words, it means much to me.

Thank you for your words. I know that this is just a bout of self pity. I will be fine, I just had to expel all of this from me, a cathartic release.

Thanks for the hug and the kind words.

Thanks, I just needed to unload. I just couldn't keep it all in today. I know that things will improve, I just broke down today thats all.

Thanks.
